faqs.a: Divide the salary by total annual hours (hours per week x weeks per year). A $52,000 salary at 40 hours x 52 weeks = $25/hour. If you work 50 hours a week, that same salary is only $20/hour.
faqs.q: How do I convert salary to hourly?

salary-to-hourly-calculator.formula:
Annual hours = hours per week x weeks per year
Annual salary = hourly rate x annual hours
Hourly rate = annual salary / annual hours
Weekly = annual / 52, biweekly = annual / 26, monthly = annual / 12
howTo: Choose the direction: hourly to salary, or salary to hourly.
Enter the hourly rate or the annual salary.
Set your hours per week and weeks worked per year.
Read all five pay periods instantly.
keyFacts: Full-time = 2,080 hours per year (40 hours x 52 weeks).
Hourly to salary: multiply the rate by total annual hours.
Salary to hourly: divide the salary by total annual hours.
Weekly, biweekly, and monthly figures all come from the same annual total.
These are gross figures - taxes and deductions are not included.
